description: Every data source the Indus research project holds or knows of, with version, location, size, identifiers, rights and acquisition route. Human-readable account: knowledge/DATA.md. Tool: tools/fetch_data.py.

status_values.held: A local copy with a recorded hash exists and matches the named edition.
status_values.partly-held: Only an excerpt, snapshot, one of several volumes or a derived table is local.
status_values.not-held: No local copy; the entry records the access route.
status_values.project-output: Produced by this project; tracked in Git or in the project's Hugging Face datasets.

location_values.local-only: Present in the owner's working copy under an ignored path; not in Git.
location_values.hf-private: Backed up to a private Hugging Face dataset owned by the project.
location_values.external: Not held; available from the named institution or publisher.

fetch_methods.git: Clone the URL and check out the pinned commit; verify listed file hashes.
fetch_methods.http: Download one public file; verify its SHA256 when recorded.
fetch_methods.manual: Follow the printed steps (browser download, purchase, library, permission request).
fetch_methods.rebuild: Regenerate from tracked code and other manifest sources.

sources.title: Koshy (epachayan/indus-script), machine-readable seal catalogues from Mackay (1938) and Marshall (1931)

version.zenodo_doi: 10.5281/zenodo.22852769 (concept DOI in README and CITATION.cff); version record 10.5281/zenodo.23281781 holds only a preprint PDF

identifiers: excavation field number (Mackay DK, SD, DK.H.; Marshall area and serial)
metadata_fields: block, house, room or street (Mackay); excavation area (Marshall)
level relative to the DK datum or SD bench mark (Mackay); depth below the modern surface (Marshall)

rights.licence: Transcribed tables CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA at the pin); code MIT (LICENSE; docs/DATA_NOTICE.md says MIT covers scripts/ only)
rights.detail: LICENSE-DATA covers transcriptions/mackay1938_seal_table/, transcriptions/marshall1931_seal_table/, transcriptions/mackay1938_plates/ and outputs/mackay_seal_table.csv, marshall_seal_table.csv, marshall_seal_table_transcribed.csv, findspots_mackay.csv, concordance_parpola_G.csv, concordance_m77_G_inferred.csv, constraints.csv. Required attribution: Nitin Stephen Koshy, "Indus script: seal catalogues and text-structure analysis" (2026), https://github.com/epachayan/indus-script. The tables were transcribed by an AI model; a 13 October check found 0 of 30 Mackay rows and 3 of 30 Marshall rows in error against the print.

sources.notes: Notice files are hashed as committed blobs because Git may convert their line endings on checkout; the four CSV files carry eol=lf and hash the same in any checkout. Use outputs/marshall_seal_table_transcribed.csv for Marshall; the repository marks outputs/marshall_seal_table.csv as a superseded OCR version. Known transcription errors against the print are listed in experiments/2026-10-13-mackay-marshall-tables/verification/print-corrections.csv. The clone may also be made with tools/fetch_data.py --fetch epachayan-mackay-marshall.
